## How to Build Your Characters

### Level Up Your Attributes

Builds in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is influenced by the character's attributes. These attributes contribute greatly to how a character performs or plays and are the deciding factor in whether the build works or not.

Make sure to level up your attributes according to the build you're going for. This is mostly decided by the **weapon** the character is using.

[Best Attributes Guide](/games/Clair-Obscur-Expedition-33/archives/515688)

### Prioritize Weapon Attribute Scaling

Weapons have **attribute scaling** and can increase a character's stats depending on what attribute scaling it has. Prioritize leveling up the attribute the weapon scales with since it'll give you **additional stats** which is beneficial in the long run.

[All Weapons and Stats Guide](/games/Clair-Obscur-Expedition-33/archives/515747)

### Match Pictos And Lumina

Pictos and Lumina are also a major part of a character's build since they can provide effects that can boost specific attacks and skills, and even offer buffs. Match Pictos and Lumina that synergize with each other to enhance the build you're planning on using.
